headline.text: L1 Sollich 1 cannot deposit chocolate due to *decorator software issue* — vendor scheduled for Monday morning.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 1 decorator has been unable to retract pins since last night — motor runs slow and software won't trigger nozzle cleaning. Sollich 3 lost temper at 10:41 on a rise pump failure and is reheating. Sollich 2 ran dark caramel after a belt-cleaning delay; lot is on hold for R&D evaluation.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 printer swapped after blurry output flagged five displays for rework. All three moulding lines ran routine cleans and passed ATP. Cleaning towel supply is critically low across shifts.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 started the weekend clean but found wrong sliders installed on depositor 1 at startup — crew is working through chocolate-hardening issues to swap them. Packaging spiral still has bars flagged from yesterday's safety chain check.

notes.text: Quarter-pallet shortage cleared when 80 units arrived at 18:11. Using 5-gallon buckets for caramel rework until 2-gallon lids arrive Monday or Tuesday.
Pallet spec pictures are being updated by Rafael for Monday's Pricemart run. Safety vest color-coding by shift rolls out Monday.
Component staging verified and signed for 3rd shift production at 05:41.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 ran out of brookies (21081)
resolved.summary: Line paused at 12:11 when WIP exhausted; crew ran CILT during the wait.
resolved.resolution: Product arrived, line running by 12:25 (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: C21 belt faulting on tracking issue
resolved.summary: Belt after detector on Sollich 3 faulted four times in ten minutes around 17:50.
resolved.resolution: Caleb York adjusted tracking, cleared by 18:06.

resolved.title: Separation band stopped on chocolate buildup
resolved.summary: Belt on Sollich 2 stopped at 03:25 due to chocolate accumulation, blocking caramel flow.
resolved.resolution: Cleared caramel and chocolate, cleaned belt, running again at 05:08 (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: Ran out of 40804 V4 trays on Sollich 2
resolved.summary: Packaging stacking on pallets without trays while waiting for warehouse delivery.
resolved.resolution: Trailer in lot being offloaded as of 10:23 (Jazmin Vazquez).

resolved.title: Quarter-pallet inventory exhausted
resolved.summary: S2 completely out of quarter pallets for 1/4 pallet rework at 17:53.

resolved.title: ML2 printer blurry, film roll incomplete
resolved.summary: Five displays flagged for rework on blurry print; film roll also showed incomplete packaging.
resolved.resolution: Printer from ML3 swapped in at end of 2nd shift, defective film roll on hold (Brandon Lance, 22:23).

resolved.title: FFS batch change 61KUC to 68GUC
resolved.summary: Line down at 18:41 to change lot code on form-fill-seal.
resolved.resolution: Batch change completed successfully at 18:48, first 15 bags verified clean (Marlenis Fernandez).

resolved.title: Black plastic pallets delayed for Pricemart order
resolved.summary: MF Matrix doing rework while waiting on SV to deliver pallets originally scheduled for Monday.
resolved.resolution: Pallets located in L1, sent to L3 by 08:14 (Itzel Chavez). Spec pictures being updated by Rafael as of 11:02.

resolved.title: Cavanna 2 FW jamming on truffle line
resolved.summary: Flow-wrap jamming up on Cavanna 2 at 21:32.

resolved.title: Mold jam in preheating cabinet, chain stretched
resolved.summary: Jam cleared, then Marcel found main engine chain for preheating stretched out and loose.
resolved.resolution: Marcel tightened chain, will walk with Nelson Cook on inspection process (Itzel, 08:58).

resolved.title: Door sensor detecting false open on cooling cabinet 5
resolved.summary: Sensor after cooling cabinet 5 showing orange and faulting door as open at startup.

resolved.title: Lockout key lost in trash
resolved.summary: ML4 employee threw away LOTO key with smock at lunch, could not find in garbage.
resolved.resolution: Form filled out, lock cut at 15:17 (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: Gondola cleaning in progress
resolved.summary: Visual inspections at 22:47 and 03:23 showed areas still needing work; team continued cleaning.
resolved.resolution: Gondola passed visual inspection and ATP test at 05:50 (Gina Vazquez).

resolved.title: Cleaning rag shortage
resolved.summary: L3 asked L1 and L2 for spare cleaning towels; both plants had none available.
resolved.resolution: Nathan found towels, L3 okay for the weekend (Tyson, 06:51).

resolved.title: Pallet damaged in staging area
resolved.summary: Someone hit a pallet with equipment in the ML4 staging area.
resolved.resolution: Itzel confirmed crew will fix it (09:30).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 decorator cannot deposit chocolate
needs_attention.summary: Motor speed maxes out in turtle mode and nozzle-cleaning window won't open to retract pins — software and speed mismatch vs Sollich 3.
needs_attention.status: Line cannot deposit as of 00:09. Sollich vendor scheduled for Monday morning per Curt Willis at 08:04.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 rise pump failure, lost temper
needs_attention.summary: Rise pump won't start, pressure very high, temper lost at 10:41. Maintenance on-site, performing reheat.
needs_attention.status: Operator purging every 10–15 minutes as of 10:41. Riser pump set at 2500; no confirmation of temper recovery by window close.

needs_attention.title: Return pump pressure elevated on Sollich 3
needs_attention.summary: Pressure at return pump hovering at 5.3–5.4 bar across multiple checks from 15:33 to 22:34.
needs_attention.status: Last reading 5.3 bar at 22:34. No corrective action or normal-range confirmation posted.

needs_attention.title: Dark, bitter caramel after belt cleaning on Sollich 2
needs_attention.summary: Caramel sat over an hour in holding kettle during separation-band fix; came out darker with bitter taste at 06:16.
needs_attention.status: Lot packed and on hold. Full jar pulled for R&D at 07:02 (Italu Martinez). No release decision in window.

needs_attention.title: Melting tank #1 chocolate level dropped 10% overnight
needs_attention.summary: Operator reported 62% at end of shift; found 52% in the morning on chocolate 10121. Cause unknown.
needs_attention.status: Victor flagged to Justin and Curt at 07:33. No investigation result or explanation in window.

needs_attention.title: Damaged pipes above S2 tempering station

needs_attention.status: Curt reviewing, checking for video. No assessment of cause or repair plan by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 kitchen and conbar still fatty after clean

needs_attention.summary: Reported at the 06:30 standup by Jody.

needs_attention.title: Wrong sliders installed on ML4 depositor 1

needs_attention.status: Correct sliders found at 10:36. Hard time installing due to chocolate drying; using hopper overheating to melt as of 11:06. No install completion posted.
